title: Ghost Ops positive-population recheck on current Last War v21

finding.result: Every sampled server completed the strict 2500/2500 Ghost-only full-world scan with zero scan failure/unread blocks, but no authentic Ghost Ops rows were published. Positive-row acceptance therefore remains population-gated rather than failed implementation.

proofBehavior: LiveManualFullGhostProof remains strict: zero rows throw 'Ordinary Manual Ghost scan published no Ghost Ops records.' Target-server support now accepts LWBRIDGE_MANUAL_SCAN_SERVER and uses the public server_jump command inside the owned lifecycle.
limits: This evidence proves clean complete scans and absent sampled population, not that Ghost Ops can never exist on these servers at another time.
No positive Ghost row was available, so B03/B13/B14/C01 positive-row field/filter/sort acceptance is not promoted.
Process runtime includes owned lifecycle startup/cleanup and is not a scan SLA.
